description:
Stop unit and integration tests from reading this repository's live `.jit/` tracker, so cargo-ci verdicts do not depend on tracker contents.

## Background

Several tests read the repository's own tracker through `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`: `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:1936` (event log) and `:1970` (issue, gate-run and index records), `crates/jit/src/declarations/gates.rs:391` (`gates.toml`), and `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_tests.rs:1094,1138,1177`. A test here depends on whichever tracker state the worktree holds, so another lead's tracker commit can change the verdict of an unrelated change. `@/inv/orthogonal-tests` requires each test to build the state it reads in storage it owns.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test under `crates/` reads this repository's live `.jit/` directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each property those tests prove is proven over a fixture or built state the test owns.
- [hard] REQ-03: Whether this repository's own records decode and round-trip is checked through a configured repository-validation gate rather than the Rust test suite.
title: Tests stop reading the live tracker
